AI Text Editor.
The message bar now has a built-in editor that can instantly
fix grammar
, translate your text or rewrite it in
several styles
:
🤝
Formal
🎯
Short
🍖
Tribal
🗿
Zen
🕯
Biblical
💼
Corp
Telegram AI features are
100% private
and optional – powered by the
Cocoon AI Network
.

Telegram now
natively supports
Live and Motion Photos.
Android and iOS users can send
animated images
right from their camera – which are viewable in
any app
.

their own prompts

unique styles

Each custom style has a
shareable link
so others users can add it to their editor.

join other chats
instantly.
